'''Jirrik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[ambassador]] residing on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ambassador Jirrik is a vendor added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in Update 4.0., who sells rewards from the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]] event. It is also possible to obtain a decoration version of Ambassador Jirrik, allowing people to place him in strongholds.<ref name="SWTOR" />
